messages:
maria.docs: Quick heads-up: we're deprecating the legacy API key header `X-Redwood-Key` in favor of `Authorization: Bearer` for SDK calls. This affects SDKs and docs; migration guide is live: https://redwood.inference/internal/docs/auth-header-migration :mag:

tom.sdk: Timeline? will old header continue to work for a while?

maria.docs: Plan: announce today, soft-warning in SDKs + Console logs starting 2026-04-05, hard enforcement (reject old header) on 2026-05-01. We'll ship warning-only releases for Node/Python this week.

kevin.eng: For Dedicated/Private customers we can allow a temporary exception if they open a ticket. Is there a flag for the runtime?

maria.docs: Yes: set env `REDWOOD_AUTH_LEGACY_OK=true` on your instance to keep accepting the old header until 2026-06-01. Support will whitelist requests. See KB template in the guide.

tom.sdk: Adding a small shim: SDKs will emit console.warn when they detect `X-Redwood-Key` and include a link to the guide. We'll keep the shim for two releases then remove.

maria.docs: Migration snippet for customers in the doc:

```
# old usage
headers = { 'X-Redwood-Key': '<API_KEY>' }

# new usage
headers = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer <API_KEY>' }
```

kevin.eng: I'll add a runtime metric to detect % of requests using the old header and post a dashboard by EOD.

deploy-bot: published internal doc: /internal/docs/auth-header-migration 1:36 UTC - scheduled public post 2026-04-06 :rocket:

maria.docs: Thanks all. Please drop any customer copy in the thread and I'll finalize.
